sanskrit: matināraḥ khalu sarasvatyāṃ dvādaśavārṣikaṃ satram ājahāra
english: Matināra performed a twelve-year sacrificial session on the banks of the Sarasvatī.

sanskrit: nivṛtte ca satre sarasvaty abhigamya taṃ bhartāraṃ varayām āsa tasyāṃ putram ajanayat taṃsuṃ nāma
english: When the sacrifice concluded, Sarasvatī herself approached and chose him as her husband; she bore him a son named Taṃsu.

sanskrit: atrānuvaṃśo bhavati
english: Here a genealogical verse occurs.

sanskrit: taṃsuṃ sarasvatī putraṃ matinārād ajījanat ilinaṃ janayām āsa kālindyāṃ taṃsur ātmajam
english: Sarasvatī bore Taṃsu as a son to Matināra; Taṃsu in turn begot his own son Ilina upon Kālindī.

sanskrit: ilinas tu rathaṃtaryāṃ duḥṣantādyān pañca putrān ajanayat
english: Ilina begot five sons on Rathaṃtarī, the eldest of whom was Duḥṣanta.

sanskrit: duḥṣantaḥ khalu viśvāmitraduhitaraṃ śakuntalāṃ nāmopayeme tasyām asya jajñe bharataḥ tatra ślokau bhavataḥ
english: Duḥṣanta married Śakuntalā, the daughter of Viśvāmitra; she bore him Bharata. On this subject two verses are cited.

sanskrit: mātā bhastrā pituḥ putro yena jātaḥ sa eva saḥ bharasva putraṃ duḥṣanta māvamaṃsthāḥ śakuntalām
english: "The mother is but the vessel; the son belongs to his father — he who was begotten is himself the father's own. Acknowledge your son, Duḥṣanta; do not despise Śakuntalā."

sanskrit: retodhāḥ putra unnayati naradeva yamakṣayāt tvaṃ cāsya dhātā garbhasya satyam āha śakuntalā
english: "The seed-bearer raises his son up from the realm of Yama, O king; you are the maker of this child within the womb — Śakuntalā speaks the truth."

sanskrit: tato 'sya bharatatvam
english: From that, his name Bharata is explained.

sanskrit: bharataḥ khalu kāśeyīm upayeme sārvasenīṃ sunandāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe bhumanyuḥ
english: Bharata married Sunandā, called Sārvasenī, a princess of the Kāśī line; she bore him Bhumanyु.

sanskrit: bhumanyuḥ khalu dāśārhīm upayeme jayāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe suhotraḥ
english: Bhumanyु married Jayā, a princess of the Dāśārha line; she bore him Suhotra.

sanskrit: suhotraḥ khalv ikṣvākukanyām upayeme suvarṇāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe hastī ya idaṃ hāstinapuraṃ māpayām āsa etad asya hāstinapuratvam
english: Suhotra married Suvarṇā, a princess of the Ikṣvāku line; she bore him Hastī, who founded this city of Hāstinapura — hence its name.

sanskrit: hastī khalu traigartīm upayeme yaśodharāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe vikuṇṭhanaḥ
english: Hastī married Yaśodharā, a princess of the Trigarta line; she bore him Vikuṇṭhana.

sanskrit: vikuṇṭhanaḥ khalu dāśārhīm upayeme sudevāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe 'jamīḍhaḥ
english: Vikuṇṭhana married Sudevā, a princess of the Dāśārha line; she bore him Ajamīḍha.

sanskrit: ajamīḍhasya caturviṃśaṃ putraśataṃ babhūva kaikeyyāṃ nāgāyāṃ gāndhāryāṃ vimalāyām ṛkṣāyāṃ ceti pṛthak pṛthag vaṃśakarā nṛpatayaḥ tatra vaṃśakaraḥ saṃvaraṇaḥ
english: Ajamīḍha had twenty-four hundred sons by Kaikeyī, Nāgā, Gāndhārī, Vimalā, and Ṛkṣā, each founding separate royal lines — and the chief line-founder among them was Saṃvaraṇa.

sanskrit: saṃvaraṇaḥ khalu vaivasvatīṃ tapatīṃ nāmopayeme tasyām asya jajñe kuruḥ
english: Saṃvaraṇa married Tapatī, the daughter of Vivasvat; she bore him Kuru.

sanskrit: kuruḥ khalu dāśārhīm upayeme śubhāṅgīṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe viḍūrathaḥ
english: Kuru married Śubhāṅgī, a princess of the Dāśārha line; she bore him Viḍūratha.

sanskrit: viḍūrathas tu māgadhīm upayeme saṃpriyāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe 'rugvān nāma
english: Viḍūratha married Saṃpriyā, a princess of Magadha; she bore him a son named Arugvān.

sanskrit: arugvān khalu māgadhīm upayeme 'mṛtāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe parikṣit
english: Arugvān married Amṛtā, a princess of Magadha; she bore him Parikṣit.

sanskrit: parikṣit khalu bāhudām upayeme suyaśāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe bhīmasenaḥ
english: Parikṣit married Suyaśā, a princess of the Bāhuda line; she bore him Bhīmasena.

sanskrit: bhīmasenaḥ khalu kaikeyīm upayeme sukumārīṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe paryaśravāḥ yam āhuḥ pratīpaṃ nāma
english: Bhīmasena married Sukumārī, a princess of Kekaya; she bore him Paryaśravā, who is known by the name Pratīpa.

sanskrit: pratīpaḥ khalu śaibyām upayeme sunandāṃ nāma tasyāṃ putrān utpādayām āsa devāpiṃ śaṃtanuṃ bāhlīkaṃ ceti
english: Pratīpa married Sunandā, a princess of the Śibi clan; he fathered three sons upon her: Devāpi, Śaṃtanu, and Bāhlīka.

sanskrit: devāpiḥ khalu bāla evāraṇyaṃ praviveśa śaṃtanus tu mahīpālo 'bhavat atrānuvaṃśo bhavati
english: Devāpi entered the forest while still a boy; Śaṃtanu became the king of the earth. A genealogical verse follows here.

sanskrit: yaṃ yaṃ karābhyāṃ spṛśati jīrṇaṃ sa sukham aśnute punar yuvā ca bhavati tasmāt taṃ śaṃtanuṃ viduḥ
english: "Whomsoever he touches with his two hands, the aged one gains ease and becomes young again — therefore they call him Śaṃtanu."

sanskrit: tad asya śaṃtanutvam
english: That is the explanation of his name Śaṃtanu.

sanskrit: śaṃtanuḥ khalu gaṅgāṃ bhāgīrathīm upayeme tasyām asya jajñe devavrataḥ yam āhur bhīṣma iti
english: Śaṃtanu married the Bhāgīrathī — Gaṅgā herself; she bore him Devavrata, who is known as Bhīṣma.

sanskrit: bhīṣmaḥ khalu pituḥ priyacikīrṣayā satyavatīm udavahan mātaram yām āhur gandhakālīti
english: Bhīṣma, desiring to please his father, gave away in marriage Satyavatī — the woman known as Gandhakālī — as his father's bride.

sanskrit: tasyāṃ kānīno garbhaḥ parāśarād dvaipāyanaḥ tasyām eva śaṃtanor dvau putrau babhūvatuḥ citrāṅgado vicitravīryaś ca
english: She had already conceived before marriage a son by Parāśara — Dvaipāyana; and upon her Śaṃtanu also fathered two sons, Citrāṅgada and Vicitravīrya.

sanskrit: tayor aprāptayauvana eva citrāṅgado gandharveṇa hataḥ vicitravīryas tu rājā samabhavat
english: Of the two, Citrāṅgada was slain by a Gandharva before reaching manhood; Vicitravīrya then became king.

sanskrit: vicitravīryaḥ khalu kausalyātmaje 'mbikāmbālike kāśirājaduhitarāv upayeme
english: Vicitravīrya married the two daughters of the king of Kāśī — Ambikā and Ambālikā, born of Kausalyā.

sanskrit: vicitravīryas tv anapatya eva videhatvaṃ prāptaḥ
english: But Vicitravīrya passed away without leaving any offspring.

sanskrit: tataḥ satyavatī cintayām āsa dauḥṣanto vaṃśa ucchidyate iti
english: Then Satyavatī reflected: "The line of Duḥṣanta's descendant is about to be extinguished."

sanskrit: sā dvaipāyanam ṛṣiṃ cintayām āsa
english: She thought of the sage Dvaipāyana.

sanskrit: sa tasyāḥ purataḥ sthitaḥ kiṃ karavāṇīti
english: He stood before her at once and said: "What shall I do?"

sanskrit: sā tam uvāca bhrātā tavānapatya eva svaryāto vicitravīryaḥ sādhv apatyaṃ tasyotpādayeti
english: She said to him: "Your brother Vicitravīrya has gone to heaven leaving no offspring — please beget children upon his wives."

sanskrit: sa param ity uktvā trīn putrān utpādayām āsa dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ pāṇḍuṃ viduraṃ ceti
english: Agreeing with the word "so be it," he fathered three sons: Dhṛtarāṣṭra, Pāṇḍu, and Vidura.

sanskrit: tatra dhṛtarāṣṭrasya rājñaḥ putraśataṃ babhūva gāndhāryāṃ varadānād dvaipāyanasya
english: There, to king Dhṛtarāṣṭra, a hundred sons were born of Gāndhārī by the boon of Dvaipāyana.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāṇāṃ catvāraḥ pradhānā babhūvur duryodhano duḥśāsano vikarṇaś citrasena iti
english: Among Dhṛtarāṣṭra's sons, four were pre-eminent: Duryodhana, Duḥśāsana, Vikarṇa, and Citrasena.

sanskrit: pāṇḍos tu dve bhārye babhūvatuḥ kuntī mādrī cety ubhe strīratne
english: Pāṇḍu had two wives — Kuntī and Mādrī — both jewels among women.

sanskrit: atha pāṇḍur mṛgayāṃ caran maithunagatam ṛṣim apaśyan mṛgyāṃ vartamānam tathaivāplutam anāsāditakāmarasam atṛptaṃ bāṇenābhijaghāna
english: Now while Pāṇḍu was roaming on the hunt, he saw a sage engaged in intercourse with a doe; even as the sage was thus immersed, still unsatiated and not yet having tasted his desire's sweetness, Pāṇḍu struck him with an arrow.

sanskrit: sa bāṇaviddha uvāca pāṇḍum caratā dharmam imaṃ yena tvayābhijñena kāmarasasyāham anavāptakāmaraso 'bhihatas tasmāt tvam apy etām avasthām āsādyānavāptakāmarasaḥ pañcatvam āpsyasi kṣipram eveti
english: Struck by the arrow, he spoke to Pāṇḍu: "You who call yourself a follower of dharma — because you, knowing better, have struck me down before I tasted the joy of love, you too shall meet this very fate: you shall pass away quickly, deprived of love's pleasure, in this very same condition."

sanskrit: sa vivarṇarūpaḥ pāṇḍuḥ śāpaṃ pariharamāṇo nopāsarpata bhārye
english: Pāṇḍu, his color drained from his face, seeking to avoid the curse, did not approach his wives.

sanskrit: vākyaṃ covāca svacāpalyād idaṃ prāptavān aham śṛṇomi ca nānapatyasya lokā santīti
english: And he said: "Through my own rashness I have brought this upon myself; and I have heard that a man without offspring has no worlds hereafter."

sanskrit: sā tvaṃ madarthe putrān utpādayeti kuntīm uvāca
english: He said to Kuntī: "Therefore you shall beget sons for my sake."

sanskrit: sā tatra putrān utpādayām āsa dharmād yudhiṣṭhiraṃ mārutād bhīmasenaṃ śakrād arjunam iti
english: She then bore sons: Yudhiṣṭhira by Dharma, Bhīmasena by the Wind, and Arjuna by Indra.

sanskrit: sa tāṃ hṛṣṭarūpaḥ pāṇḍur uvāca iyaṃ te sapatnyanapatyā sādhv asyām apatyam utpādyatām iti
english: Pāṇḍu said to Kuntī with a joyful countenance: "Your co-wife has no offspring — please arrange for a child to be born of her as well."

sanskrit: sa evam astv ity uktaḥ kuntyā
english: Kuntī agreed, saying "So be it."

sanskrit: tato mādryām aśvibhyāṃ nakulasahadevāv utpāditau
english: Thereupon Nakula and Sahadeva were begotten upon Mādrī by the twin Aśvins.

sanskrit: mādrīṃ khalv alaṃkṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍur bhāvaṃ cakre
english: Seeing Mādrī adorned and beautiful, Pāṇḍu was stirred with passion.

sanskrit: sa tāṃ spṛṣṭvaiva videhatvaṃ prāptaḥ
english: The very moment he touched her, he passed away.

sanskrit: tatrainaṃ citāsthaṃ mādrī samanvāruroha
english: There Mādrī ascended the funeral pyre where he lay.

sanskrit: uvāca kuntīm yamayor āryayāpramattayā bhavitavyam iti
english: She said to Kuntī: "The noble lady must raise the twins with unwavering care."

sanskrit: tatas te pañca pāṇḍavāḥ kuntyā sahitā hāstinapuram ānīya tāpasair bhīṣmasya vidurasya ca niveditāḥ
english: Then the five Pāṇḍavas, together with Kuntī, were brought to Hāstinapura by the forest ascetics and presented to Bhīṣma and Vidura.

sanskrit: tatrāpi jatugṛhe dagdhuṃ samārabdhā na śakitā viduramantritena
english: There too an attempt was made to burn them in the lac-house, but it could not succeed owing to Vidura's counsel.

sanskrit: tataś ca hiḍimbam antarā hatvā ekacakrāṃ gatāḥ
english: And having slain Hiḍimba along the way, they went to Ekacakrā.

sanskrit: tasyām apy ekacakrāyāṃ bakaṃ nāma rākṣasaṃ hatvā pāñcālanagaram abhigatāḥ
english: There in Ekacakrā too, having slain the demon named Baka, they proceeded to the city of Pāñcāla.

sanskrit: tasmād draupadīṃ bhāryām avindan svaviṣayaṃ cājagmuḥ kuśalinaḥ
english: From there they obtained Draupadī as their wife and returned safely to their own realm.

sanskrit: putrāṃś cotpādayām āsuḥ prativindhyaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ sutasomaṃ vṛkodaraḥ śrutakīrtim arjunaḥ śatānīkaṃ nakulaḥ śrutakarmāṇaṃ sahadeva iti
english: They also begot sons: Yudhiṣṭhira fathered Prativindhya, Vṛkodara fathered Sutasoma, Arjuna fathered Śrutakīrti, Nakula fathered Śatānīka, and Sahadeva fathered Śrutakarmā.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhiras tu govāsanasya śaibyasya devikāṃ nāma kanyāṃ svayaṃvare lebhe tasyāṃ putraṃ janayām āsa yaudheyaṃ nāma
english: Yudhiṣṭhira also won at a svayaṃvara a maiden named Devikā, daughter of Govāsana of the Śibi clan, and fathered upon her a son named Yaudheya.

sanskrit: bhīmaseno 'pi kāśyāṃ baladharāṃ nāmopayeme vīryaśulkām tasyāṃ putraṃ sarvagaṃ nāmotpādayām āsa
english: Bhīmasena also married Baladhārā, a princess of Kāśī, won by valor, and fathered upon her a son named Sarvaga.

sanskrit: arjunaḥ khalu dvāravatīṃ gatvā bhaginīṃ vāsudevasya subhadrāṃ nāma bhāryām udavahat tasyāṃ putram abhimanyuṃ nāma janayām āsa
english: Arjuna went to Dvāravatī and married Subhadrā, the sister of Vāsudeva; he fathered upon her a son named Abhimanyu.

sanskrit: nakulas tu caidyāṃ kareṇuvatīṃ nāma bhāryām udavahat tasyāṃ putraṃ niramitraṃ nāmājanayat
english: Nakula married Kareṇuvatī, a princess of the Cedi, and fathered upon her a son named Niramitra.

sanskrit: sahadevo 'pi mādrīm eva svayaṃvare vijayāṃ nāmopayeme tasyāṃ putram ajanayat suhotraṃ nāma
english: Sahadeva also won at a svayaṃvara Vijayā, herself a Mādrī princess, and fathered upon her a son named Suhotra.

sanskrit: bhīmasenas tu pūrvam eva hiḍimbāyāṃ rākṣasyāṃ ghaṭotkacaṃ nāma putraṃ janayām āsa
english: Bhīmasena had earlier also fathered upon the demoness Hiḍimbā a son named Ghaṭotkaca.

sanskrit: ity ete ekādaśa pāṇḍavānāṃ putrāḥ
english: These then are the eleven sons of the Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit: virāṭasya duhitaram uttarāṃ nāmābhimanyur upayeme tasyām asya parāsur garbho 'jāyata
english: Abhimanyu married Uttarā, the daughter of Virāṭa; the child conceived in her womb was stillborn.

sanskrit: tam utsaṅgena pratijagrāha pṛthā niyogāt puruṣottamasya vāsudevasya ṣāṇmāsikaṃ garbham aham enaṃ jīvayiṣyāmīti
english: Pṛthā received that six-month foetus in her lap, at the command of the supreme Vāsudeva, saying: "I shall restore this one to life."

sanskrit: saṃjīvayitvā cainam uvāca parikṣīṇe kule jāto bhavatv ayaṃ parikṣin nāmeti
english: Having revived him, she declared: "Born when the family was brought to ruin, let this one be named Parīkṣit."

sanskrit: parikṣit tu khalu mādravatīṃ nāmopayeme tasyām asya janamejayaḥ
english: Parīkṣit married a princess named Mādravatī; she bore him Janamejaya.

sanskrit: janamejayāt tu vapuṣṭamāyāṃ dvau putrau śatānīkaḥ śaṅkuś ca
english: From Janamejaya and Vapuṣṭamā were born two sons: Śatānīka and Śaṅku.

sanskrit: śatānīkas tu khalu vaidehīm upayeme tasyām asya jajñe putro 'śvamedhadattaḥ
english: Śatānīka married a princess of Videha; she bore him a son named Aśvamedhadatta.

sanskrit: ity eṣa pūror vaṃśas tu pāṇḍavānāṃ ca kīrtitaḥ pūror vaṃśam imaṃ śrutvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
english: Thus the lineage of Pūru and of the Pāṇḍavas has been recounted; one who hears this line of Pūru is freed from all sins.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca ikṣvākuvaṃśaprabhavo rājāsīt pṛthivīpatiḥ mahābhiṣa iti khyātaḥ satyavāk satyavikramaḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: There was a king who sprang from the Ikṣvāku line, lord of the earth, renowned as Mahābhiṣa — truthful in speech and true in valor.

sanskrit: so 'śvamedhasahasreṇa vājapeyaśatena ca toṣayām āsa devendraṃ svargaṃ lebhe tataḥ prabhuḥ
english: With a thousand aśvamedha sacrifices and a hundred vājapeya rites he pleased the lord of gods, Indra, and thereby that powerful king attained heaven.

sanskrit: tataḥ kadā cid brahmāṇam upāsāṃ cakrire surāḥ tatra rājarṣayo āsan sa ca rājā mahābhiṣaḥ
english: On one occasion the gods assembled to attend upon Brahmā; among them were the royal sages, and king Mahābhiṣa was also present.

sanskrit: atha gaṅgā saricchreṣṭhā samupāyāt pitāmaham tasyā vāsaḥ samuddhūtaṃ mārutena śaśiprabham
english: Then Gaṅgā, the foremost of rivers, came to approach the Grandfather; the wind blew aside her garment, white as moonlight.

sanskrit: tato 'bhavan suragaṇāḥ sahasāvāṅmukhās tadā mahābhiṣas tu rājarṣir aśaṅko dṛṣṭavān nadīm
english: Thereupon all the hosts of gods suddenly cast their eyes downward — but the royal sage Mahābhiṣa gazed upon the river without hesitation or shame.

sanskrit: apadhyāto bhagavatā brahmaṇā sa mahābhiṣaḥ uktaś ca jāto martyeṣu punar lokān avāpsyasi
english: Mahābhiṣa was censured by the venerable Brahmā, and was told: "You shall be born again among mortals, and then win back these worlds."

sanskrit: sa cintayitvā nṛpatir nṛpān sarvāṃs tapodhanān pratīpaṃ rocayām āsa pitaraṃ bhūrivarcasam
english: That king, having reflected among all the ascetic kings, chose Pratīpa — a man of great splendor — as the father he wished to be born from.

sanskrit: mahābhiṣaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā nadī dhairyāc cyutaṃ nṛpam tam eva manasādhyāyam upāvartat saridvarā
english: The best of rivers, seeing that king Mahābhiṣa fall from his composure, turned her mind and heart upon him alone.
